facts.fact: INTIC's draft Regulamento dos Servicos de Computacao em Nuvem, in public consultation from 2025-02-24 (day inferred from the consultation window, the document's published date), says in Art. 11(2) that classified information may be handled only in private clouds and must always stay in national territory unless the regulator expressly authorises otherwise.
